newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar stays firm, trade muted.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar stays firm, trade muted.

text.p: London's spot March white sugar contract nudged higher in light activity but trading was light as holiday festivities took their toll and the raws market failed to inspire, traders said on Friday.
At 1709 GMT the two nearby contracts had backed off their earlier highs as players took profits but activity was generally thin across the board.

March stood $1.50 higher at $305.20 and May was up $1.70 at $305.00, in a light total volume of 561 lots. Traders said little activity was expected next week due to the early pre-Christmas close but the recent bearish sentiment was likely to remain due to abundant supply of quality whites, normal for the season.
The Paris market mirrored activity in London as the spot Matif contract dominated the overall turnover.
March was up $1.50 at $305.50 and May was unchanged at $303.50.
